title: Qualification Check
heading: Qualification Number
intro: To check if the person is qualified to operate the equipment or an approved member to distribute the product, please enter their qualification/certification number in the search box. It may take up to 7 days for new certifications to be updated.
label: Qualification Number
hint: New certifications can take up to 7 days to appear.

errors.failed: We couldn’t run the check just now. Please try again.

result.positiveBody: This number matches a Hollywood Whitening qualification.
result.negativeBody: No, this is not a qualified representative.
result.unknownBody: Please try again in a moment. If the certification was issued recently, it may take up to 7 days to appear.
